notablePrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.
